class.name: DSContext
class.brief_description: Core singleton manager for DirectStorage hardware acceleration and fallback backends in Godot.
class.description: [DSContext] manages the lifecycle of the DirectStorage runtime, memory queues, staging buffers, and software fallback backend. The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSContext"[/code]. Use [method initialize_ds] before submitting requests, then call [method flush_batch] after enqueuing requests. The addon autoload normally performs this per-frame flush automatically.

method.name: get_active_backend_name
method.description: Returns the active backend name. The DirectStorage backend is named [code]"Win32DirectStorage"[/code]; the software backend is named [code]"SoftwareFallback"[/code]. Returns [code]"None"[/code] before initialization.

method.name: cancel_requests_with_tag
method.description: Cancels all enqueued read requests whose cancellation tag matches [param tag].

method.name: enqueue_request
method.description: Enqueues a configured [DSRequest] into the active I/O queue. The request is not submitted until [method flush_batch] is called. Returns [code]true[/code] if it was accepted; a null request or unavailable backend returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: flush_batch
method.description: Submits all requests currently queued to the DirectStorage runtime or software fallback worker pool. Request completion is reflected in each request's [member DSRequest.status].

method.name: get_disable_gpu_decompression
method.description: Returns whether GPU decompression has been disabled.

method.name: get_drive_info
method.description: Returns drive capability information for [param path], including [code]drive[/code], [code]bus_type[/code], [code]file_system[/code], [code]directstorage_supported[/code], and, when applicable, [code]reason[/code].

method.name: get_queue_capacity
method.description: Returns the maximum number of requests allowed in a queue. The default is [code]2000[/code].

method.name: get_staging_buffer_size_mb
method.description: Returns the configured staging buffer size in MiB. The default is [code]128[/code].

method.name: initialize_ds
method.description: Initializes DirectStorage hardware queues and staging buffers. Returns [code]true[/code] if initialized successfully.

method.name: is_d3d12_backend
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when DirectStorage is supported and Godot is using a valid Direct3D 12 logical device.

method.name: is_current_drive_supported
method.description: Returns whether the drive containing the running executable supports DirectStorage.

method.name: is_path_supported
method.description: Returns whether the drive containing [param path] supports DirectStorage. This does not initialize the runtime.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the native Windows DirectStorage backend is available. A software fallback can still initialize on unsupported platforms, but this method remains [code]false[/code].

method.name: shutdown_ds
method.description: Shuts down DirectStorage queues, releases COM interfaces, and cleans up active backend resources.

method.name: set_disable_gpu_decompression
method.description: Enables or disables GPU decompression for subsequent initialization and requests.

method.name: set_queue_capacity
method.description: Sets the maximum queue capacity used by the backend.

method.name: set_staging_buffer_size_mb
method.description: Sets the staging buffer size in MiB. A value less than or equal to zero restores the default of [code]128[/code] MiB.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], forces DirectStorage runtime to perform CPU decompression instead of GPU decompression shaders.
The maximum request capacity for the DirectStorage queue. The default is [code]2000[/code].
The size in megabytes of each staging buffer allocated by DirectStorage.
